tags.gist: Describes a system where the clinician prompts the generation and reviews each output before the patient sees it, calling it clinician-directed content, not a recommendation.
Wants devices whose clinician previews and approves every directive output to rank below autonomous-delivery devices on the activity axis.
Wants sponsors allowed to restrict users to clinicians trained in a defined modality, with labeling and access controls lowering the risk tier.
Says the safety elements treat provoking distress as failure, misclassifying exposure-therapy devices; wants a therapeutic-calibration sub-element or per-device reinterpretation.
Wants a prespecified feasibility-stage study with validated outcome measures allowed to serve as both clinical confirmation and benchmarking evidence for small sponsors.
Wants an explicit branching point separating content-generation devices from world-model devices, whose risk lies in predictive fidelity, before choosing benchmarking elements.
